facts.summary: FDA issued second Complete Response Letter, deeming single-arm trial inadequate · BLA resubmission · tabelecleucel in EBV+ PTLD · not yet approved
facts.indication: Epstein-Barr virus positive post-transplant lymphoproliferative disease (EBV+ PTLD)

evidence.summary: the CRL claims that the single arm ALLELE trial, which was previously confirmed by the FDA as adequate to support the BLA filing, is no longer considered to be adequate to provide evidence of effectiveness for accelerated approval.
evidence.safety: the FDA confirmed that the GMP compliance issues had been satisfactorily resolved, and importantly, no safety issues were raised.
evidence.program_discontinued: PFP and Atara plan to urgently interact with the FDA to find a path forward for the timely accelerated approval of EBVALLO
